statements.text: AI is REALLY smart and seems like it can hack almost anything… don’t you think maybe it can hack voting machines?

I’ve been all over. I meet with foreign leaders of democracies and I always ask how they conduct their elections.

Recently, I was in Armenia and discovered they require their citizens to vote by taking an electronic fingerprint AND show their ID — and if they don’t match they arrest them (good!) 

When they learn many states don’t even require an ID or proof of citizenship, they laugh. It’s an embarrassment.

As the most important, powerful, and richest country in the world, our elections should be THE BEST, where no one has any doubts. With the rise of AI our elections are going to be even more vulnerable. We must get our elections in order fast.

Without free, fair, and honest elections — NOTHING else matters.
